title: Database Administrator
description:
Job Description Database Administrator (DBA ) 
 Position 
 Database Administrator (DBA) 
 8+ Years 
 Experience 
 Employment Type 
 Work Location 
 Department 
 Full-Time 
 Greater Noida / Delhi NCR 
 IT / Infrastructure / Database Administration 
 IT Manager / Project Manager 
 Reporting To 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator with 8+ years of hands-on experience in database 
 administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, security, and troubleshooting. The 
 candidate will be responsible for maintaining reliable, secure, highly available, and high-performing database 
 environments supporting enterprise and mission-critical applications. 
 Key Responsibilities 

 Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain database servers and related database components. 
 Administer and manage production, staging, development, and disaster-recovery database environments. 
 Monitor database health, availability, capacity, performance, and resource utilization. 
 
 Perform SQL query optimization, indexing, execution-plan analysis, and database performance tuning. 
 Design, implement, and regularly test backup, restore, recovery, and disaster-recovery procedures. 
 Implement and maintain high-availability and replication solutions such as clustering, mirroring, Always On, Data 
 Guard, or equivalent technologies. 
 
 Identify and resolve database incidents, performance bottlenecks, connectivity issues, locking/blocking, deadlocks, 
 and data integrity problems. 
 
 Manage database users, roles, privileges, authentication, access controls, and security policies. 
 Perform database migration, consolidation, upgrade, and version-integration activities. 
 Work closely with application developers, DevOps, infrastructure, security, and project teams to support application 
 releases and deployments. 
 
 Develop and maintain database standards, SOPs, operational documentation, monitoring dashboards, and recovery 
 runbooks. 
 
 Participate in capacity planning, infrastructure planning, change management, and production support activities. 
 Automate routine DBA activities using scripting and database utilities wherever practical. 
 Support audits, compliance requirements, vulnerability remediation, and database security reviews. 
 Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior database administrators and support teams. 
 Required Technical Skills 

 Strong hands-on experience with at least one major RDBMS such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or 
 MySQL. 
 Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, functions, triggers, indexing, and execution-plan 
 analysis. 
 Strong knowledge of database architecture, normalization, transactions, locking, concurrency, and data integrity. 

 Hands-on experience with backup and recovery, point-in-time recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity. 
 Experience with high availability, replication, clustering, and failover concepts. 
 Strong troubleshooting and performance-tuning capabilities. 
 Working knowledge of Linux/Unix and/or Windows Server environments. 
 Knowledge of database monitoring and administration tools. 
 Experience with scripting/automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or equivalent is preferred. 
 Understanding of cloud database services such as AWS RDS/Aurora, Azure SQL/Managed Instance, or Google Cloud 
 database services is an advantage. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 Relevant DBA certification such as Microsoft, Oracle, PostgreSQL, AWS, Azure, or equivalent is preferred. 
 Experience supporting enterprise applications and 247 production environments. 
 Experience in government, PSU, banking, healthcare, or other mission-critical environments is an advantage. 
 Key Competencies 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Excellent incident management and troubleshooting ability. 
 Ability to work under pressure in production environments. 
 Strong communication and coordination skills. 
 Good documentation and knowledge-sharing practices. 
 Ability to independently manage database operations while collaborating with cross-functional teams. 
 Performance Expectations 

 Maintain high database availability and reliability. 
 Ensure timely backup verification and recovery readiness. 
 Proactively identify and resolve performance and capacity issues. 
 Minimize production incidents and database-related downtime. 
 Maintain security, access control, documentation, and operational compliance. 
 Interested candidate can share the resume on this email id :- mansi.gupta@echttech.com

Key Skills: DBA Skills,Postgresql Database Administration,MySQL Database Administration,Postgresql,Database administration,Administration,DBMS,MySQL

 Job Summary:   
 We are seeking a skilled Database Administrator (DBA) with a strong focus on PostgreSQL to join our dynamic team in Gurugram. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years of experience in database management, with a proven track record of working with PostgreSQL. This role requires a detail-oriented professional who can ensure the performance, integrity, and security of our databases while providing support for database-related issues.

 Responsibilities: 

Design, implement, and maintain PostgreSQL databases, ensuring high availability and performance.
Monitor database performance and implement tuning and optimization strategies.
Perform regular database backups and recovery operations to ensure data integrity and availability.
Develop and implement database security policies and procedures to safeguard sensitive information.
Collaborate with development teams to design and optimize database schemas and queries.
Provide support for database-related issues, troubleshooting and resolving problems as they arise.
Document database configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices in database management. 
 Mandatory Skills: 

Extensive experience with PostgreSQL, including installation, configuration, and administration.
Strong understanding of database design principles and data modeling.
Proficiency in SQL and PL/pgSQL for writing complex queries and stored procedures.
Experience with database backup and recovery strategies.
Knowledge of performance tuning and optimization techniques for PostgreSQL. 
 Preferred Skills: 

Experience with cloud-based database solutions (e.g., AWS RDS, Azure Database for PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with other database management systems (e.g., MySQL, Oracle).
Knowledge of database monitoring tools and performance analysis.
Experience with database migration and upgrade processes.
Understanding of data warehousing and ETL processes. 
 Qualifications: 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in PostgreSQL or database management are a plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
